WRITING TEST 4
        OCCUPATIONAL ENGLISH TEST
        WRITING SUB-TEST: MEDICINE
        TIME ALLOWED:
        READING TIME: 5 MINUTES
        WRITING TIME: 40 MINUTES
        Read the case notes and complete the writing task which follows.
        Notes:

Patient: Chadwick Hooper (Mr.)
DOB: 26/01/1993
Ht: 175 cm
Wt: 75 kg
BMI: 24.50(13/02/2018)

Social History: Bar Tender
Single
Smoker-2-3 cigarettes/day
Alcoholic
Substance Intake: Nil
Allergies: Peanuts, seafood

FHx: Father Mr. Hooper Simon, taxi driver, 55 yrs, alcoholic, diabetes
   Mother Mrs. Monica Hooper, 50 yrs, homemaker, Hypertension.

PMHx:
1998 chicken pox, mumps
2005 RTA
2016 viral fever
 
13/02/2018
Subjective: complaints of persistent frontal headache, nausea& blurring of
vision for 6 hours, no family and history of headache.
Objective : Physical examination done: No photophobia, neck stiffness.
Visual acuity – normal; no other abnormal changes detected.
Advised to rest & given tab. Paracetamol q4h.
26/02/2018
Visited the clinic again with severe left sided throbbing frontal headache
along with
Blurred vision, 3 episodes of vomiting & right sided parasthesia.
Objective : Distressed, Vital signs: T-36.7; p-112 bpm & B.P-160/95,
Peripheral nervous system
Normal.
Rx: Stat-pethidine 100 mg, intramuscular injection maxolone 10 mg given.
Plan for review after 24 hrs if condition persists.
6/04/2018
Home visit
Subjective: fell down at home after 3 hours of excruciating left sided
headache.
Complaining of parathesia in right arm and leg, impaired LOC & Slurring of
speech.
Objective : P-100 bpm, B.P-155/90, Increased knee jerk on right knee
,reflexes-normal.
Assessment: Probable intracranial pathology, space occupying lesions.
Plan: Needs urgent admission in emergency department.

       Writing task:
Using the information in the case notes, write a letter of referral for further
assessment and management of this patient to the Neurologist, Dr Michael
Biggs, North Shore Private Hospital, 3 Westbourne St, St Leonards NSW
